inputFields.name: alwaysIncludeServerUrl
inputFields.description: Indicates whether to include the server URL for an absolute URL path. Otherwise, a relative path will be generated.

inputFields.name: disableLanguageEmbedding
inputFields.description: Indicates whether to disable language embedding. To disable embedding the language in the URL path, set the value to true.

inputFields.name: language
inputFields.description: The language to use in the generated URL.

inputFields.name: siteName
inputFields.description: The site name to use for generating URL.
